Dr. Anand R. Shenoy is a cardiologist in Bengaluru, who is currently associated with the Manipal Hospitals, Old Airport Road, Bengaluru, as a Consultant in Interventional Cardiology. He has many degrees to his name, including MBBS, MD, DM, FICC, FSCAI, MEAPCI, FESC, FACC, and FRCP (ED). He specialises in ischaemic heart disease treatment, CAD, angioplasty (PTCA), device closure, primary PCI, and lastly, peripheral interventional pacemakers. He has conducted many seminars and published research papers and articles that are vital to medical students today. At Manipal Heart Foundation, under the International Journal of Cardiology, he conducted a seminar on non-surgical septal reduction for hypertrophic cardiomyopathy in childhood. Another seminar he conducted was on perimembranous SCD closure using a duct occluder at the same place. He presented a paper in Buenos Aires, Argentina, at the Fourth World Congress of Paediatric Cardiology and cardiac surgery. He presented a case report at the Manipal Heart Foundation on PTSMA in childhood and percutaneous RSOV closure using a duct occluder. In March 2004, he presented at IJN’s first live course in paediatric cardiology, which was held in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. In July 2003, he showcased his expertise at St. John’s Medical College Hospital, Bangalore, India, for the Indian Heart Journal on transcatheter closure of aortopulmonary window using an Amplatzer device. A month prior to this, he conducted a seminar on acquired aortopulmonary fistula at the same place. He has conducted several other talks and seminars, and his research papers are cited by students globally. Dr. Shenoy is a top heart specialist in Old Airport Road.

Dr. Shenoy is a renowned member of many medical societies within the country and globally as well. He is a Fellow of the Society of Cardiovascular Angiography and Interventions in the USA and a member of the European Association of Percutaneous Coronary Interventions. He is also a Fellow of the Indian College of Cardiology and a Fellow of the European Society of Cardiology. Along with speaking four languages (Hindi, English, Kannada, and Konkani), Dr. Anand R. Shenoy has received many awards and achievements for his work and research. He has received training in LMCA Intervention at ASAN Medical Centre, Seoul, S. Korea. He has also received training in CTO and Retrograde technique at Kamakura and Yokohama in Japan under Dr. Shigeru Saito and Dr. Muramatso. He was also awarded the Cochrane Research Scholarship award in 2010. Some of the services provided by Dr. Shenoy include cardiac catheterisation, carotid angioplasty and stenting, mitral/heart valve replacement, CT angiogram, acute aortic dissection, cardiothoracic surgery, cardiac rehabilitation, echocardiography, BP monitoring, stress echocardiography, device closure for congenital heart diseases, dobutamine stress test, FFR (fractional flow reserve), trans-oesophageal echo, and PAMI. Overall, he has completed over 4000 angioplasties and more than 8000 successful interventions.

Dr Sridhara G. is associated with the Manipal Hospitals, Old Airport Road, Bengaluru as an Interventional Cardiology and Cardiac Electrophysiology Consultant. Dr. Sridhara’s field of experience covers decades of hard work. He worked on cardiac interventions as well as diagnostic procedures performed in CathLab for over 14 years. He completed his MBBS from Bangalore Medical College in Bangalore and his MD degree from Maulana Azad Medical College in New Delhi. He also completed his DM degree from the Postgraduate Institute of Medical Education and Research (PGIMER) in Chandigarh. Dr. Sridhara G. has conducted many seminars and published many research papers that are cited by students worldwide. At an API conference in New Delhi in 2001, he presented his research work while gaining his MD degree. In 2004, he presented more of his research at a CSI conference in Bangalore while obtaining his DM degree. With a passion for social work, he went to the Tumkur as well as Kolar districts to conduct and organise health camps. His research work as an MD student was published in the Indian Practitioner Journal in 2002. The Indian Journal of Cardiology published his work on device closure of  VSD, ASD, and PDA in 2004 and Cyanotic Spells in the Tetralogy of Fallot in 2005. Certain medical websites have also published his work. Neurology India published an article by him on strokes being a rare presentation of cardiac amyloidosis in March 2003. Express Healthcare published his article on the treatment and prevalence of coronary artery calcification. Dr. Sridhara is the best cardiologist in Old Airport Road.

Dr. Sridhara has gained experience working as an interventionist for coronary and structural heart diseases. He has saved many lives by performing many primary percutaneous interventions for patients suffering from heart attacks. He is the best cardiologist in Bangalore, specialises in cardiac electrophysiology for the treatment of cardiac arrhythmias. He is experienced in performing cardiac electronic device implantations, which include setting up pacemakers of CRT-P and CRT-D types. His interests also lie in performing electrophysiology ablation procedures for SVT such as AVNRT and accessory pathways. Additionally, the doctor specialises in performing atrial flutter and idiopathic VT ablations. He conducts these by using 3D electro-anatomical mapping systems. He is also an expert in the paediatric catheterisation procedure, including device closure. Dr. Sridhara G. is known for his kind nature towards his patients; he can speak English, Hindi, Telugu, and Kannada, which ensures efficient communication with his patients from diverse backgrounds. He has won many awards at national and university levels, including the Rotary Gold Medal for MD Medicine in the year 2001 from Delhi University; the Nova Nordisk Educational Grant Award for Best Research Work in Diabetes at the National Level; and The Gold Medal for applying Fuzzy Logic for the diagnosis of CAD in PHC (Institution of Engineers of India). Furthermore, he is a renowned member of many medical societies in India, including the Cardiological Society of India, the Indian Heart Rhythm Society, the Indian Association of Clinical Medicine, and the Asia Pacific Heart Rhythm Society.

As a consultant in Cardiology, he is recognised as a valuable contributor to the medical community at Manipal Hospitals, Old Airport  Bangalore. His excellent patient care and commitment have earned him a reputation as one of the leading practitioners in his field today. Dr. Chakrapani B.S. specialises in Interventional Cardiology and Invasive and Non-invasive Cardiology. He is a Diplomate of the National Board in Internal Medicine from JJM Medical College & National Board of Examination, New Delhi. He has performed more than 6000 invasive cardiac procedures. He has been in the first group to start the era of Primary Angioplasty for Acute Myocardial Infraction India. He also has experience in Nuclear Cardiology from the TATA Memorial Hospital in Parel, Mumbai. Dr. Chakrapani is well known for his expertise in conducting critical surgeries and his understanding of the latest technological advancements. He is a respected leader in his field for his ability to diagnose and deliver quality patient care. He is a foremost cardiologist in Old airport road Bangalore.

Dr. Chakrapani B.S. passed his Bachelor of Science from Mysore University. He earned his MBBS from JJM Medical College under Mysore University in Davangere. Dr. Chakrapani enrolled in Lokmanya Tilak Hospital & Municipal Medical College in Mumbai under Mumbai University to pursue his Doctor of Medicine in Cardiology. He also passed DNB in Internal Medicine from NBE - New Delhi Senior Residency in Cardiology under Nizam Institute Of Cardiology. Dr. Chakrapani is the best cardiologist in Bangalore. In 2000, he deftly managed ICCU on Wheels project in Karnataka and established the Cardiac Care Centre at Tumkur. The ICCU on Wheels projects offered a state of art facilities, including Pre-hospital thrombolysis, pulse oximeter, temporary pacemaker, ventilator and tele electro cardiology. It was a joint venture with Tumkur and Manipal Heart Foundation, Manipal Hospitals, Bangalore, and Rotary Midtown of Bangalore. This colossal project provided cost-effective cardiac care at the doorstep of rural and semi-urban populations. This project facilitates critical patient care from H2H or home to hospital, manages risk stratification, ICCU and transfers the patient to MHF for emergency coronary angioplasty and other procedures.

 Dr. Chakrapani B.S received the CSI Group Award for his exemplary contribution to Cardiology. Dr. Chakrapani has presented and published various papers at cardiology conferences. He is a lifetime member of the Association of Physicians of India, the Indian Medical Association, the Cardiological Society of India and a member of the National Academy of Medical Sciences in New Delhi. Dr. Chakrapani is fluent in Kannada, Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, and English. His ability to converse in different languages contributes to his ability to treat and understand patients from various backgrounds and locations. Dr. KSS Bhat is an immensely experienced and renowned Cardiologist whose career spans over four decades, starting from 1970. He is a highly accomplished doctor and dedicated consultant renowned for his skills, knowledge, extensive experience and dedication to delivering excellent patient care. He is an important contributor to the medical community and has earned a reputation due to his accurate diagnosis. He is currently practising at Manipal Hospital and Heart Lung Clinic in Bangalore. He is an expert in Ischemic Heart Disease, preventive cardiology, clinical cardiology, heart failure and hypertension. He specifically takes an interest in areas of preventive cardiology, clinical research and public health education. He previously practised at Heart Lung Clinic and Diagnostic Centre in Bangalore. He is also an experienced teacher of medicine both nationally and globally. In India, he has shared his expertise with the students of AIIMS or All India Institute of Medical Sciences in New Delhi and the HAL Hospital in Bengaluru. He has also taught students of overseas institutions, namely, Otago Medical School of New Zealand and the AI Fatah University Medical School in Libya. He graduated with MBBS, later pursued MD in General Medicine, and became a FACC (Fellow, American College of Cardiology). He also acquired a Diploma in Tuberculosis and Chest Diseases (DTCD). He pioneered the week-long Preventive Cardiology program for physicians and the public in 1991, a part of the Bangalore Heart Project in 1989 in Manipal Hospitals. Dr. Bhat is a foremost interventional cardiologist in Oldairportroad, Bangalore.

Dr. KSS Bhat is a Fellow of the Royal Australian College of Physicians (FRACP) and a fellow of the Indian College of Cardiology (FICC). He is a Trustee of the Medical Education and Research Trust of Bengaluru. He was previously the President of the Indian Medical Association of Bengaluru South-East Branch. He has been the President of the Cardiological Society of India under the Bangalore and Karnataka Chapter. Dr. KSS Bhat has received several accolades to honour his contribution to medical sciences. He was honoured by the Cardiology Society of India in Karnataka and Bangalore Chapter. He was also honoured by the Association of Paediatricians of India under the Karnataka Chapter. Dr. KSS Bhat has also contributed to several publications. In 2005, he wrote an article on the Role of Aldosterone in the Cardiology Update. In 2006, Dr. Bhat contributed a chapter on Type II Diabetes and the role of insulin in Insulin Resistance and Endothelial Changes. He also wrote about Stress and Heart Disease in the Text Book of Cardiology in 2013. If you are looking forward to consulting an expert cardiologist in Bangalore, Dr. KSS Bhat can ideally guide you for cardiological treatments.

He has a wide variety of experience in diagnosing and treating Malignant Haematologic disorders like Acute and Chronic Leukemias, Lymphomas, Myeloma; Red Cell Disorders like Aplastic Anaemia, Nutritional Anaemia, Thalassemia, Sickle Cell Anaemia; Platelet disorders like Immune thrombocytopenic purpura-ITP; Thrombotic Disorders like Deep Vein Thrombosis and more. Dr. Hemant K Kalyan is a highly renowned Orthopaedician in Bangalore who is currently practising at Manipal Hospitals Old Airport Road as a Consultant - Orthopaedic & Robotic Joint Replacement Surgery. With over 30 years of experience, his expertise extends to various areas of orthopaedics, including robotic hip and knee replacements, partial knee replacements,  fracture surgery with minimally invasive techniques, sports injuries, and arthroscopic surgery. After completing his MBBS, Dr. Hemant Kalyan went on to pursue an MS in Orthopaedics from the University of Bombay where he was awarded the D. Ortho Gold Medal in 1989, a testament to his academic excellence. He has also obtained an International Fellowship in Arthroscopy & Knee Surgery from the University of Toronto. He is a foremost consultant orthopaedic surgery in Oldairportroad, Bangalore. 

The year 1991 marked a monumental milestone in Dr. Kalyan's illustrious career: he emerged as a pioneer, etching his name as the first Indian to be honoured with a Diploma in Sports Medicine from the esteemed Scottish Royal Colleges. He was among the pioneering Orthopaedic Surgeons who established their practice in Bengaluru in 1993, laying the foundation for the city's growing reputation as a hub for sports medicine and orthopaedic care. Dr. Hemant K Kalyan's commitment to providing exceptional care led him to conceptualise and found the renowned outpatient facility OSSICARE in 2004. He introduced advanced techniques in arthroscopy, elevating patient care.

Performing over 8,867 surgeries, including 1,416 joint replacements and 102 robotic joint replacements under his belt at Manipal Hospitals, Dr. Kalyan has left an indelible mark through his surgical expertise, educational endeavours, and groundbreaking research. His wealth of knowledge has been shared with the world through 123+ guest lectures at esteemed national and international conferences. Dr. Kalyan has showcased his work through 18 publications in reputable journals, disseminating valuable insights to fellow professionals. In 2018, The Economic Times recognised his exceptional contributions and featured him as one of the top 25 ‘Inspiring Orthopaedicians of India’. He is also a proud member of the AO Trauma Asia Pacific (AO TAP), Indian Association of Sports Medicine (IASM), Indian Orthopaedic Association (IOS), Indian Society of Hip and Knee Surgeons (ISHKS), Indian Arthroscopy Society (IAS), and the Indian Medical Association (IMA). Dr. Kalyan's multilingual proficiency in English, Kannada, Hindi, Gujarati, Marathi, and Tamil fosters trust and understanding among a diverse patient population. Dr. Hemant K Kalyan's dedication and passion shine through in the exceptional care he provides for which he is regarded as one of the best orthopaedic surgeons in Bangalore and India.

Dr. Mala Sibal is a Fetal Medicine Consultant working in Bangalore. She is associated with the Manipal Hospitals at Old Airport Road in Bangalore. She is highly educated with various medical degrees like MBBS, DGO, and DNB. She is experienced for more than 25 years in the field of gynaecology and ultrasound. She has been working with Manipal Hospitals since 2002. Dr. Sibal is an MBBS graduate of the Jawaharlal Nehru Medical College in Belgaum. She graduated in 1987 and pursued DGO from St John's Medical College in Bangalore in 1991. She appeared for the Post Graduate DNB Exams in Obstetrics and Gynaecology 1997. She took the training in ultrasound from Diwakar Hospital in Bangalore. She won the 'Best Outgoing Girl' award during her MBBS years. She also stood first in the subject of Gynaecology during her college time. Dr. Mala has worked internationally as well. She was a Gynaecologist in Ahwaz, Iran, for three years at the National Iranian Oil Company hospital. She is the only Indian investigator in ongoing International Ovarian Tumour Analysis research studies. She is the Principal Investigator of the team. She is a part of the International Society of Ultrasound in Obstetrics and Gynaecology. She also works as the International Faculty for the Society for training doctors in gynaecological ultrasound. Dr. Mala is the best perinatologist in Bangalore.

Dr. Mala wrote a book named 'Ultrasound in Gynaecology- An Atlas and Guide' in 2017, which currently has over 38,000 downloads and was well-received by experts. Her article titled 'Gel Sonovaginography: A New Way of Evaluating a Variety of Local Vaginal and Cervical Disorders' was published in the American Institute of Ultrasound in Medicine journal. She has also participated in training and workshops for doctors since 2005. The IOTA group has authorised her to conduct certificate courses in 2018. She has conducted workshops more than 22 times in different cities. More than 1600 doctors have been a part of her courses, and 60% have passed successfully. She is IOTA's Ambassador for India and Asia. Besides fetal medicine, Dr. Mala is an expert in ultrasound, gynaecology, and obstetric ultrasound. In her career, she has performed fetal invasive procedures like fetal reduction, amniocentesis, CVS, and cordocentesis. She has also successfully done ultrasound-guided procedures like cyst aspirations and tru-cut biopsy. Dr. Mala has been to many international conferences as a speaker. She has given over 350 guest lectures in 44 cities and 13 countries. She is the Course Director and Faculty at 'Gynaecology Academy', an online portal for the skill enhancement of gynaecologists. She is a member of MUSK (Medical Ultrasound Society of Karnataka) and the Society of Fetal Medicine in India. She can speak Persian apart from Kannada, English, and Hindi.

Dr. Dubey guarantees excellent communication and individualised treatment for patients from various backgrounds because he is fluent in English, Hindi, Kannada, and Tamil. Dr. Bhavana M.V. is an experienced microbiologist in Bangalore. She is currently practicing as a Consultant - Microbiology and Head of Laboratory Medicine at Manipal Hospital, Old Airport Road, Bangalore. With over 12 years of experience, Dr. Bhavana specialises in diagnostic microbiology, antibiotic stewardship, infection control, and quality management in laboratory medicine. She is dedicated to improving patient outcomes through accurate diagnostics, operational excellence, and interdisciplinary collaboration.

Dr. Bhavana completed her MBBS from J.J.M. Medical College, Davangere, and earned her MD in Microbiology from M.S. Ramaiah Medical College, Bangalore. She has earned several certifications, including a Certificate Course in Healthcare Management from ISB and an Infectious Disease Certificate Course from PD Hinduja Hospital, Mumbai. Throughout her career, Dr. Bhavana has delivered guest lectures at national and international conferences and has contributed over 25 publications to medical journals.

In her current role, Dr. Bhavana oversees diagnostic reporting across various disciplines, including bacteriology, mycology, mycobacteriology, molecular pathology, and flow cytometry. She is pivotal in formulating hospital antibiograms and antibiotic policies, managing antibiotic stewardship programs, and implementing infection control practices. Additionally, Dr. Bhavana ensures adherence to accreditation standards, managing audits conducted by organisations like NABH and NABL. She is also involved in research, quality management, and training programs for laboratory staff, ensuring that the laboratory operates with the highest safety and efficiency standards.

Dr. Bhavana has previously served as the Quality Manager for Laboratory Medicine and was instrumental in implementing the quality management system across the department in compliance with ISO 15189:2012. She was also appointed as the nodal officer for COVID-19 testing at Manipal Hospital, where she played a key role in setting up the COVID lab and managing testing protocols during the pandemic.

Her academic background, leadership, and passion for continuous improvement make Dr. Bhavana a respected figure in microbiology and laboratory medicine.

Dr. Bhavana is fluent in Kannada, English, and Hindi, allowing her to communicate effectively with patients and colleagues from diverse backgrounds. She is a member of several prestigious organisations, including the Indian Medical Association (IMA), the Indian Association of Medical Microbiologists (IAMM), and the Hospital Infection Society—India.

Dr. Shankar is the best radiologist in Bangalore. Apart from being an expert in radiology, he has expertise in cardiovascular imaging, cardiac MRI, and musculoskeletal imaging. He has also worked with cardiac CT, coronary CT, and MR peripheral angiography. He has handled many complicated medical cases successfully in his career. He has successfully performed Foam Sclew Therapy, laser ablation, radiofrequency ablation, IVC tumour repair, and conservative and interventional management of DVT. He advises patients about diabetic foot care. He has also performed an angioplasty, peripheral angiography, stenting, venoplasty, and Endoluminal Aneurysm. Dr Nitin S. Shetty is a well-known and compassionate physician. He has influenced many eye problems that are diagnosable, treated, and managed today. He is also an expert on treating uveitis, retinopathy (ROP) and retinopathy. Dr Nitin S Shetty is a well-known and successful ophthalmologist. He is a consultant at Retina Services in Ophthalmology and HOD at Old Airport Road in Bangalore. He got his Vitreo-Retina fellowship at Chennai’s Sankara Nethralaya Medical Research Foundation. Since then, he has worked with quite a few organisations. Some of these include the Vitreo Retina Society of India and the American Academy of Ophthalmology. Dr Shetty’s key specialities include the medical retina, surgical retina, and uveitis. His expertise includes diagnosing, caring for, and treating retinal problems. These include diabetic retinopathy, age-related macular degeneration, retinal vein occlusions, and drug toxicity. Dr Shetty is a surgeon who performs vitreoretinal procedures for various retinal issues. This involves eye injuries, vitreous haemorrhage and retinal detachments. He also has the skills and knowledge necessary to analyse, identify and treat a variety of uveitis situations. This includes frontal, intermediate, and posterior uveitis. For comprehensive patient care, he works with pulmonologists and rheumatologists. No wonder is considered a highly acclaimed opthalmologist in Bangalore.

Dr Nitin S. Shetty is fluent in English, Hindi, Kannada, Marathi, and Tulu. This allows him to connect with and communicate with various patients. The doctor has had extra training in screening, laser, and surgical treatment of retinopathy of prematurity (ROP). He also has a particular interest in hereditary retinal diseases. From 1994-2003, he served as Vitreo-retinal and uveitis consultant at his alma mater. He was awarded his college's VT Joshi Award for Best Outgoing Fellow. He also cleared his MBBS in Ophthalmology with distinction. He also published books on Fluorescein Angiography and contributed chapters in several publications. He is frequently invited as a guest speaker at various state, national, and international conferences. He was a visiting scholar at the Chinese University of Hong Kong from 1999-2000. Dr Shetty is an excellent medical professional. As a result, he has made remarkable contributions to the field. His extensive understanding of uveitis, ROP, surgical and medical retina, and ophthalmic surgery allows him to offer his patients the best possible care. Dr Nitin Shetty continues to have a tremendous impact on the lives of the individuals he treats by using a caring approach and a dedication to developing the field. His commitment allows him to provide excellent patient care because of his comprehensive experience and knowledge.

Dr. Ullas V. Acharya is a highly successful Consultant in Neuroradiology and Radiology, currently working at the Manipal Hospitals, Old Airport Road, Bengaluru. Dr. Acharya has contributed significantly to the fields of interventional radiology and neuroimaging. After earning his MBBS, he did his MD in Radiodiagnosis at Kasturba Medical College (KMC), Manipal. He acquired a DM in Neuroimaging and Interventional radiology from the reputed National Institute of Mental Health and Neuro Sciences (NIMHANS) in Bengaluru to further his love of the field. This extensive school background demonstrates his commitment to developing intense knowledge and skills in his field. Dr. Acharya's memberships and fellowships in several prestigious scientific organisations, such as the Indian Medical Association, the Indian Radiological and Imaging Association, the Indian Society of Neuroradiology, and the Society of Therapeutic Neurointervention, serve as evidence of his expert competence. These associations demonstrate his enthusiastic involvement with peers and commitment to remaining current with developments in his area. Neuro-interventional methods for both diagnosis and treatment are under Dr. Acharya's area of competence. He specialises in carrying out numerous stroke operations, including carotid artery stenting, mechanical thrombectomy for acute major vascular occlusions, and cerebral venous sinus thrombosis recanalisation. He also specialises in treating aneurysms, dural arteriovenous fistulas in the brain and spinal cord, and preoperative tumour embolisations. His contributions in these fields have greatly enhanced patient outcomes and solidified his standing as a knowledgeable interventional radiologist. Dr. Acharya is a foremost consultant neuroradiology in Old Airport Road, Bangalore.

Dr. Acharya actively promotes his knowledge and experience through publications in national and international journals, as well as guest talks at local conferences, outside of his profession as a clinician. Additionally, he has taught specialised courses and workshops, such as an Advanced Neuroimaging Workshop for radiologists in Hyderabad and an MRI physics training for GE and Philips engineers. His efforts to advance healthcare professionals' knowledge of neuroimaging and interventional radiology are demonstrated by these activities. Dr. Acharya has received several accolades and accomplishments because of his commitment to his profession and his services to the medical community. For his quiz, paper, and poster presentations at numerous national and international conferences, he has won praise. Notably, he received the IJRI's Dr. G.R. Jankharia Best Paper Award. He has also been allowed to participate in international neuro-interventional conferences, which will help him deepen his knowledge of and connections with experts in his field. In addition to his professional accomplishments, Dr. Acharya is fluent in Hindi, Kannada, and English, which allows him to effectively communicate with a broad spectrum of patients. Dr. Acharya has recently been actively interested in spreading the word about COVID-19's effect on the rates of stroke death. To lessen the negative impacts of the pandemic on stroke victims, he has underlined the necessity for heightened monitoring and prompt intervention with his respected colleagues Dr. N. S. Santhosh, Dr. Manjunath Mahadevappa, and Dr. Paritosh Pandey.

Dr. Raj Vigna Venugopal is a highly accomplished gastroenterologist in Bangalore, currently associated with Manipal Hospital Old Airport Road as the Head of the Department and Consultant - Medical Gastroenterology. His areas of interest include Advanced Therapeutic Endoscopy, EUS-guided Procedures, Third Space Endoscopy Procedures (POEM, ESD, EMR), Gastro-oncology, and Inflammatory Bowel Disease. Dr. Raj was instrumental in setting up the First Endo-sonography Unit in Karnataka in 2006 while performing many therapeutic EUS-guided procedures. He has been one of the pioneers in performing Third-space Endoscopy Procedures in the region and has the highest number of per-oral endoscopic myotomy (POEM) procedures to his credit. He is the Best Gastroenterologist Doctor in Bangalore

Dr. Raj Vigna Venugopal’s medical journey began with an MBBS from Kerala University, followed by an MD - Internal Medicine from the Manipal Academy of Higher Education. He further specialised in Gastroenterology with a DM from the Sanjay Gandhi Post Graduate Institute of Medical Sciences. Dr. Raj's clinical training is equally extensive, including a Rotating Internship at TD Medical College, Alappuzha, Kasturba Medical College, and Endoscopic Ultrasound Training at the Calamite-Paoli Cancer Institute in Marseille, France, and many others. His residency experiences in Gastroenterology at Amrita Institute of Medical Sciences in Kochi, Christian Medical College in Vellore, and SGPGIMS in Lucknow provided him with a robust foundation in his speciality.

The contributions of Dr. Raj Vigna Venugopal in the medical field include significant research in gastroenterology. His work also includes research on the differentiation of Crohn’s disease and tuberculosis, palliation of gastric outlet obstruction in advanced carcinoma gallbladder, and the outcomes of endoscopic therapy in recurrent acute and chronic pancreatitis associated with pancreas divisum. Throughout his career, Dr. Raj has presented his findings at numerous national and international conferences. He has also discussed management strategies for chronic hepatitis B in children and participated as a panellist in discussions about constipation at various forums.

Dr. Raj's teaching experience is notable, having trained undergraduate and postgraduate students during his tenure as an assistant professor at AIMS, Kochi. Since 2013, he has been conducting the DNB - Gastroenterology course at Manipal and has guided numerous students in their thesis work. He has also conducted the national DNB exit exam in 2020. Besides, Dr. Raj is a member of several professional bodies, including the Indian Society of Gastroenterology, the Society of Gastrointestinal Endoscopy of India, the Indian National Association for the Study of Liver Diseases, and the Indian Medical Association. His dedication to teaching and training DNB gastroenterology students, along with his numerous publications and conference presentations, underscore his commitment to advancing the field of gastroenterology and providing exceptional patient care.

Dr. Lalchand Hirachand Bandagi is an experienced cardiothoracic and vascular surgeon in Bangalore. He is currently practising as a Consultant – Cardiothoracic & Vascular Surgery at Manipal Hospital Old Airport Road, Bangalore. With over a decade of comprehensive clinical experience, Dr. Bandagi has developed deep expertise in adult and paediatric cardiothoracic surgeries, minimally invasive procedures, and complex redo operations Heart and Lung Transplantations, Lung Surgeries, ECMO. His commitment to precision surgery, patient safety, and critical care has earned him a strong reputation in the field of cardiovascular and thoracic medicine.

After completing his MBBS from Shivaji University, Kolhapur, Dr. Bandagi pursued a Master of Surgery (MS) in General Surgery at MRMC, Gulbarga, under RGUHS. He then specialised in Cardio-Thoracic & Vascular Surgery (M.Ch) from Sri Jayadeva Institute of Cardiovascular Sciences & Research, Bangalore. His solid academic foundation has been complemented by extensive clinical exposure, enabling him to take on intricate surgical challenges with confidence and finesse. Over the years, he has consistently performed high-risk surgeries involving coronary artery bypass grafting (CABG), total arterial grafting, valve repair and replacements, congenital heart defect correction, and end-stage heart and lung failure management using ECMO.

Dr. Bandagi has held key roles at leading institutions, including Associate Consultant at Manipal Hospital (since 2013). He has consistently demonstrated a commitment to clinical excellence, multidisciplinary collaboration, and advanced patient care protocols. His work involves handling complex congenital cases such as TOF, TAPVC, DORV, Ebstein anomaly, and TGA, as well as adult procedures like off-pump CABG, valve repairs, and aortic aneurysm repair. His training in managing end-stage organ failure includes expertise in heart and lung transplantation and prolonged ECMO support.

In addition to his surgical practice, Dr. Bandagi is a passionate educator with significant experience teaching medical students, surgical residents, and nursing teams. He employs a structured, case-based approach to academic instruction, ensuring practical learning in both operating theatre and outpatient settings. His sessions include surgical anatomy, emergencies, and radiology interpretation, delivered through bedside rounds, operative tutorials, and academic presentations.

Dr. Bandagi’s academic contributions also include paper presentations at national conferences like IACTS 2013, where he shared insights on supraclavicular approaches for dysphagia lusoria, rare right atrial tumours, and mediastinal mass surgeries. His sharp diagnostic acumen is matched by a solid foundation in critical care and trauma management, which allows him to maintain high standards of care even in emergency settings. His leadership has also extended to hospital administration, resource planning, clinical quality control, and strategic healthcare improvement initiatives.

Equipped with strong clinical judgement, an analytical mindset, and a dedication to innovation, Dr. Bandagi is also involved in developing protocols for high-risk patients, fostering early health-seeking behaviour, and ensuring adherence to evidence-based treatment pathways. Dr. Bandagi is fluent in English, Hindi, Kannada, Marathi, and Telugu, which allows him to effectively engage with a diverse patient population and provide care tailored to their unique needs.

Venkatesh is a household name among the residents of Bengaluru, as he is a highly skilled and competent medical professional with a calm and friendly approach, with more than 30 years of experience in treating kids and teenagers. After completing his undergraduate course, Dr. Venkatesh opted for a DNB course in the field of Paediatrics. This paediatrician also had hands-on training as an observer at NICU Boston’s Tufts Medical Center located in the USA. Paediatric Critical Care Medicine, paediatrics, asthma, and paediatric allergy are his areas of expertise. He was the first to create Neonatal Neurosonography and Neonatal Functional Echocardiography Certification programs with Manipal University approval to train and nurture budding neonatologists. Dr. Venkatesh has published several research works and papers at different conferences that have received immense appreciation from his peers in the paediatric arena. He has also published about 35 books under international and national publishers. He also guides the students doing postgraduate thesis programs for the DNB course in the neonatology field. His extensive years of experience in the field of neonatology and paediatrics has helped him achieve immense fame, awards, and recognition at national and international level. Dr. Ravi Shankar Swamy is a highly regarded neonatologist renowned for his proficiency in Bayley Scales-based neuro-developmental evaluation. He is a part of the Royal College of Paediatrics and Child Health (UK) and holds several degrees. He has a great grasp the understanding of the unique and complex challenges of treating children because of his schooling. Dr. Ravi gained experience and a reputation for treating children at The Royal College of Paediatrics and Child Health (MRCPCH).

After completing his clinical neonatology training, he received a Certification of Completion of Training (CCT) in Neonatal Grid Training. He was a neonatal consultant at the Royal London Hospital before departing for India. Dr. Ravi has completed research training in neurodevelopmental outcomes in children, continuing his commitment to deepening our understanding of developmental problems in pediatric patients. His master's and doctoral degrees are both from Newcastle University.

Dr. Ravi is also a member and fellow of the Royal College of Paediatrics and Child Health demonstrates his dedication to professional excellence and lifelong learning. He is passionate about teaching and has taken training sessions to develop his pedagogical skills. Dr. Ravi is a pioneer in using digital practices in his professional practice. He is an expert user of the Bayley-III, a valuable tool for assessing kids with developmental problems.

Dr. Ravi has received several honours and medals for his contributions to the medical community. He received the Times Healthcare Awards as a Rising Star for his exceptional achievements and potential. Additionally, he serves as a national trainer for the Bayley Scales of Infant and Toddler Development III (BSID III). He oversees India's highly regarded Neonatal Emergencies Simulation Team (NEST) Training initiative.

To represent the London-based Royal College of Paediatrics and Child Health in India, he has been named an examiner elect for MRCPCH Clinical Examinations. He also works as the HELIX trial's lead researcher as an honorary research associate at Imperial College London. This experiment investigates the effectiveness of whole-body cooling for infants with encephalopathy. He has also enhanced his medical knowledge by submitting study pieces to prestigious medical publications. His lectures and publications have emphasised the need to provide women and their newborns with thorough postnatal care.

Dr. Ravi is a consultant paediatrician and neonatologist at Cares Women and Children's Clinic in Seegehalli and Manipal Hospital in Whitefield. He is a well-respected, reputed, skilled, and in-demand medical expert in his industry because of his untiring devotion to patient care and research.

Dr. Mugdha Shahi is a highly skilled and experienced Consultant in Foetal Medicine, currently practising at Old Airport Road in Bengaluru, India. With a passion for providing comprehensive care to expectant mothers and their unborn babies, Dr. Shahi specialises in various aspects of foetal medicine, ranging from early pregnancy scans to complex interventions. Dr. Shahi's journey in the field of medicine began with her completion of her MBBS (Bachelor of Medicine, Bachelor of Surgery), followed by DNB (Diplomate of National Board) in Obstetrics and Gynaecology. Eager to expand her knowledge and expertise in foetal medicine, she pursued a Fellowship in Foetal Medicine and Foetal Therapy at Mediscan Systems in Chennai. Furthermore, she obtained extra qualifications and memberships with prestigious organisations, including the Foetal Medicine Foundation (FMF) in the UK, the International Society of Ultrasound in Obstetrics and Gynaecology (ISUOG), and the Society of Foetal Medicine India. Dr. Shahi is the best perinatologist in Bangalore.

With various talent sets, Dr. Shahi presents an intensive variety of services in the area of foetal medicine. She excels in conducting dating and early pregnancy scans, which play a crucial role in estimating gestational age and assessing the well-being of the embryo. Additionally, she specialises in first-trimester screening (NT), performing anomaly scans to detect any structural abnormalities in the developing foetus. Dr. Shahi's expertise extends to conducting foetal echocardiography, a detailed examination of the foetal heart to identify potential cardiac issues. Moreover, Dr. Shahi is adept at performing interval growth and Doppler scans, enabling her to monitor the growth and blood flow within the foetus throughout the pregnancy. Her proficiency also extends to conducting 3D and 4D scans, providing expectant parents with a more detailed and realistic view of their unborn child.

Additionally, Dr. Shahi offers her services for second opinions and the monitoring of high-risk pregnancies, including twin and multiple pregnancies. In cases where intervention is required, Dr. Shahi is well-versed in various invasive procedures. These include amniocentesis and chorionic villus sampling, both of which involve obtaining samples for genetic testing. She is also experienced in multi-foetal reductions, a procedure that selectively reduces the number of foetuses in multiple pregnancies to improve outcomes. Furthermore, she possesses the skills to perform intrauterine transfusions, radiofrequency ablation, and interstitial laser procedures for complicated twin pregnancies, ensuring the best possible care for both the mother and the babies. Alongside her clinical expertise, Dr. Shahi is committed to providing pre-pregnancy and genetic counselling. By offering guidance and support, she empowers couples to make informed decisions regarding their reproductive health and assists in identifying any potential genetic risks.

Dr. Mugdha Shahi is fluent in English, Hindi, and Marathi, enabling her to effectively communicate with patients from diverse backgrounds and provide personalised care. Her compassionate approach and dedication to excellence make her a trusted and respected professional in the field of foetal medicine. With her vast knowledge, skilful techniques, and commitment to the well-being of both mother and child, Dr. Shahi continues to positively impact the lives of numerous families on their journey to parenthood.

Dr. Shalina Ray is an Otorhinolaryngologist and a specialist in ear, nose, and throat conditions. She has an experience of more than 25 years, during which she has performed advanced ear surgeries, sleep apnea surgeries, and paediatric ear, nose, and throat surgeries. She is highly educated with degrees like MBBS, DLO, and MS. She works at the Manipal Hospital in the Whitefield area of Bangalore city as a Consultant- Ear, Nose, and Throat. She completed her MBBS from the B.J. Medical College in Ahmedabad. She completed her MD from the same college in the year 1999. She worked as a Clinical Fellow in head and neck surgery at the Tata Memorial Hospital in Mumbai and got advanced training in the field. In 2002 she went to London to work at the Dunstable Hospital, where she was a Resident Doctor for nearly six years. It was only the beginning of her extensive international exposure. Later, she took advanced training in Coblation Tonsillectomy, Adenoidectomy, and sleep apnea surgeries in England and became a member of the General Medical Council of the country. She also got a membership in the Royal College of Surgeons of the United Kingdom in 2006. She underwent advanced training in Endoscopic Sinus Surgeries at the Singapore General Hospital. She has also worked in the United States at the House Ear Institute in Los Angeles, California. She was trained in advanced Otology in the hospital. She is the best ENT surgeon in Bangalore.

She has experience doing facial nerve surgeries, salivary gland surgeries, thyroplasty, Laser Microlaryngeal Surgery, and rhinoplasty. She got trained in Laser and Laryngeal Voice Surgery at the KEM hospital in Mumbai. She is an expert in performing laser-assisted laryngeal surgeries, Endoscopic Advanced Sinus Surgeries, paediatric ear surgeries, and sleep apnea or snoring surgeries. She counsels patients about managing vertigo, allergies, and tinnitus. She has dealt with countless ENT emergencies, such as nasal bleeding, airway obstruction, and removal of foreign bodies. Her articles have been published in reputed medical journals like the International Journal of Medical Science and Current Research, the Indian Journal of Anatomy and Surgery of Head, Neck and Brain, and the Annals of Royal College of Surgeons of England. She has written about topics like Hyperbaric Oxygen Therapy in Post-Covid Mucormycosis, unusual cases of Epistaxis, intranasal myopericytoma, etc. She was part of a randomised controlled trial to compare Triadcortyl with 10% glycerine-ichthammol during the treatment of severe acute otitis externa. The trial is now a part of the European Archives of Oto-Rhino-Laryngology. She has also written a case report about chylous cysts, which was published in the Indian Journal of Anatomy and Surgery of Head, Neck and Brain in the year 2019.

Dr. Bhaskar Shenoy is a highly experienced HOD & Consultant - Paediatrics and Consultant - Pediatric Infectious Diseases at Manipal Hospital Old Airport Road, Bangalore with impressive qualifications and an extensive professional background. As a paediatrician in Bangalore, Dr. Bhaskar Shenoy holds great expertise in the fields of General Paediatrics, Paediatric Infectious Disease, Vaccinology, Immunization, and Kawasaki Disease. He has undergone specialized training through courses offered by the European Society of Pediatric Infectious Diseases (ESPID) and the World Health Organization (WHO). He is the foremost Paediatrician in Bangalore. 

Dr. Bhaskar Shenoy earned his MBBS from Mysore Medical College, followed by an MD in Paediatrics from Karnataka Medical College. Further enhancing his expertise, he obtained a Diploma in Infectious Diseases from New South Wales University and Apollo Medvarsity, as well as a Certificate in Infection Control. His academic achievements culminated with the prestigious Fellowship of the Royal College of Pediatrics and Child Health (FRCPCH) in the UK.

In addition to his clinical practice, Dr. Shenoy has made substantial contributions to medical education. He served as an Associate Professor of Pediatrics for 8 years at Dr. BR Ambedkar Medical College, Bangalore. He has also been a faculty member in the DNB teaching program for 15 years. He also coordinated the IAP ID Fellowship Program for a decade, showcasing his commitment to mentoring future paediatricians and infectious disease specialists.

Dr. Shenoy’s role in immunisation activities is noteworthy, having been a member of the Advisory Committee on Vaccination & Immunization Practices (ACVIP) and the convener of the immunisation advisory committee of the Karnataka State IAP. Moreover, Dr. Bhaskar’s scholarly contributions include a vast array of important publications in reputable journals. He has also authored and edited several books on paediatric infectious diseases, infection control, and evidence-based paediatrics, further cementing his influence in the field.

Dr. Shenoy has been honoured with several awards and orations, including the Dr. P C Bopaiah Endowment Oration by IAP Bangalore and the Dronacharya Award for CME Excellence. He was also the recipient of the Bill Melinda Gates Travel Award in 2023 and the First Best Case Rounds Award in 2022 by ESPID, reflecting his exceptional contributions to paediatric infectious diseases.

Dr. Ratnavalli Subbarao is a highly experienced neurologist in Bangalore with over 20+ years of clinical expertise. She is currently practising as a Consultant in neurology at Manipal Hospital Old Airport Road. An expert in cognitive neurology and dementia, Dr. Ratnavalli specializes in managing memory disorders, Parkinson’s disease, stroke, epilepsy, and headaches. She made history by establishing India’s 1st Memory Clinic in 1998 and has since led the multidisciplinary Cognitive Neurology Clinic at Manipal Hospital, where she has evaluated over 1000+ patients from across the country. Her work has significantly advanced the understanding and management of neurodegenerative disorders and cognitive impairments.

Dr. Ratnavalli earned her MBBS from Kasturba Medical College and went on to complete her MD in General Medicine from Jagadguru Jayadeva Murugarajendra Medical College, Davangere. She further specialized by obtaining a DM in Neurology from Christian Medical College, Vellore, and later pursued a Commonwealth Fellowship in Cognitive Neurology from the American Academy of Neurology in Cambridge, UK. Her academic excellence is reflected in her earning the prestigious research grant under the Cognitive Science Research Initiative by the Department of Science and Technology in 2015, recognizing her valuable contributions to the field.

Dr. Ratnavalli is also actively involved in academic and professional communities. In 2014, she spearheaded the introduction of the DNB Neurology course at Manipal Hospital Old Airport Road, significantly enhancing the training of future neurologists. She is a life member of the Bangalore Neurological Society, the Indian Stroke Association, and the Neurological Society of India. In 2020, she was elected as a Steering Committee Member of the Alzheimer’s Association PIA-Cognition, further cementing her leadership in dementia care. She has also co-organized national conferences and organized the World Federation of Neurology teaching course in Cognitive Neurology in 2012, reflecting her commitment to continuous professional development and education.

Her scholarly contributions include a highly cited first-author paper - ‘The Prevalence of FTD (frontotemporal dementia)’, which has garnered several citations in the Neurology journal. Over the years, she has contributed significantly to the study and treatment of many neurological illnesses, concentrating in particular on uncommon and complex cases involving the nervous system and the human brain. Dr. Ratnavalli is also involved in community outreach programs apart from clinical practice, which is proven by her commendable work for NGOs like Nightingale Medical Trust to spread awareness about dementia and stroke.

Fluent in English, Hindi, and Kannada, Dr. Ratnavalli communicates effectively with a diverse patient population, ensuring that every patient receives comprehensive care and a clear understanding of their treatment options.

He has been working in this field for more than 16 years and currently works at the Manipal Hospital in the city's Whitefield area. He is a consultant in Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation and is also the Head of the Department there. He completed his MBBS in the year 2006. He studied at the Vijayanagara Institute of Medical Sciences. The college is situated in Bellary in the state of Karnataka and he worked there as a Junior Resident too. He has worked on complex medical cases related to Fibromyalgia, Osteoarthritis, Osteoporosis, and Cerebrovascular accidents.

Dr Dheeraj has a life membership of the Indian Federation of Neurorehabilitation. He has a Post-doctoral Neurological Rehabilitation fellowship from the National Institute of Mental Health and Neuro Sciences in Bangalore. He worked as a Consultant at the St John's Medical College Hospital for one year before joining Manipal Hospitals. He has treated nerve disorders, muscular disorders, and musculoskeletal pain. He has also written about other topics like Sleep Disorders in Children with Cerebral Palsy and its relation to sleep disturbance in primary caregivers. He has worked in the area of obesity management and managing lifestyle diseases like blood pressure and diabetes. Dr. Dheeraj is the best physical medicine physician in Whitefield, Bangalore.

He has given lectures at CME (Continuing Medical Education) conferences about geriatric rehabilitation, stroke rehabilitation, and paediatric rehabilitation (rehabilitation of children and infants). He has managed patients with Myopathies, Neuropathies, traumatic brain injuries, and multiple trauma. He has worked on treating patients having traumatic brain injuries, spinal cord injuries, neuromuscular disorders, and diabetic foot. He has guided his patients about cancer, amputation, pressure ulcer, cerebral palsy, movement disorders, and balance disorders. He studied the topic 'Nerve Conduction Studies on Median and Ulnar Nerves of Patients with Rheumatoid Arthritis' for writing his dissertation.

He is an expert in Neurological Rehabilitation, Geriatric Rehabilitation, and Paediatric Rehabilitation as well. He has lectured at various conferences on orthosis prescription, delayed development disorders in children, rehabilitation after a stroke, and other comprehensive rehabilitation approaches. He completed his MD in Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation from the All India Institute of Medical Sciences located in New Delhi He worked at the All India Institute of Medical Sciences of New Delhi as a Junior Resident and as a Senior Resident doctor. He worked at St John's Medical College as a professor of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation.

Dr. Davinder Singh Chadha is a well-known Interventional Cardiology Consultant who is currently associated with Manipal Hospital, Old Airport Road, Bangalore. Dr. Chadha also holds considerable experience in intravascular lithotripsy, the treatment of arrhythmias with ablation and pacemakers, coronary artery surgery, the treatment of congestive heart failure, intravascular imaging, implantation, CRT devices, coronary interventions, structural heart disease, cardiac outpatient procedures, endovascular interventions, left main angioplasty, TAVI, rotational atherectomy, and bifurcation angioplasty. He graduated with MBBS from AFMC Pune University and acquired his M.D. in Medicine from AFMC Pune University in Pune, Maharashtra. He also pursued his D.M. in Cardiology from the same university. Dr. Chadha further pursued Hons in FRCP (E). He went on to acquire his fellowship from the Royal College of Physicians in the U.K. He has been the Examiner in D.M. (Cardiology) at RGUH Bangalore, Pune University, and Tamil Nadu University in Vellore. Dr. Chadha is an acclaimed interventional cardiologist at Old Airport Road. 

Dr. Davinder Singh Chadha has worked in the medical field for over 23 years in the field of cardiology. Over the years of his service, he performed numerous OCT procedures. He has performed more than over 400 rotational atherectomy surgeries and nearly 10000 non-coronary and coronary intervention surgeries over the past years. Moreover, he operated several complicated interventions comprising carotid and BTK. In South India, he also conducted intravascular lithotripsy operations for calcific coronary artery disease. Dr. Chadha created the TAVI program at each Command health centre in Bangalore and AFMC Pune, where he has performed 12 TAVI surgeries in the last two years. He conducted the first TAVI operation in 2016. He is praised for his kind and compassionate treatment of his patients. He is also fluent in speaking languages like English, Hindi, and Punjabi.

Dr. Chadha’s talks and publications include papers in national as well as international journals. For his work on Trans collateral Renal Angioplasty for a completely Occluded Renal Artery, he was awarded the Best Challenging Case Award. Notably, He received the important HQ Southern Command Gold Medal, the Silver Medal, and the General B. Basu Rolling Trophy for finishing first in college in Ophthalmology in the final MBBS test. He also received a Gold Medal for achieving first place in college in surgical procedures in the most recent MBBS exams. Some of the services provided by the doctor include FFR (fractional flow reserve), trans-oesophageal ECHO, Dobutamine stress test, device closure for congenital heart diseases, ambulatory blood pressure monitoring, PAMI, Holter monitoring, TAVI (transcatheter aortic valve implantation), pacemaker implantation, acute aortic dissection, repair of adult coarctation, and Patent Ductus Arteriosus device closure. Dr. Davinder Singh Chadha has also served as the main investigator on several international and ICMR-funded clinical trials, and he has published over 70 publications in national and international journals.

Dr. Archana M. works as a Children's Infectious Disease Doctor in Whitefield. She is one of the well-known paediatric infectious disease physicians in Bangalore who is well-qualified to tackle complicated and serious infections, general pediatric infections. Overall she has an experience of 14 years in this field, with 8 years of experience as a specialist. She is very knowledgeable and specialises in fields like treating infections of various types caused by general infections, hospital-acquired infections, tropical infections, infections in immunodeficient children, complicated infections, and prolonged fevers. She also specialises in immunisation in healthy babies and special situations. She is the foremost Children Infectious Disease Doctor in Whitefield.

Dr. Archana is a life member of medical bodies like the Indian Academy of Paediatrics (IAP) and the Indian Medical Association (IMA). She also possesses memberships from the renowned European Society of Paediatric Infectious Diseases. Dr. Archana M completed her MBBS degree from Bangalore’s Kempegowda Institute of Medical Sciences (KIMS) in 2009. She completed her DNB course in Paediatrics at the Coimbatore Masonic Medical Centre for Children in Tamil Nadu in 2013. She then proceeded to acquire a fellowship in Paediatric Infectious Diseases from the Indian Academy of Paediatrics in 2018. Dr. Archana has undergone in-depth training for 24 months in the field of paediatric infectious diseases from the University of Oxford, the premier educational institute in London. 

Her areas of interest include antibiotic stewardship, preventing and controlling diseases caused by various infections, vaccinations and medications for kids during travel, immunity shots during special situations, management of prolonged episodes of fever, treating infections in immunocompromised kids, tuberculosis treatment, management of infections in babies affected during pregnancy and childbirth, and AIDS or HIV treatment. Dr. Archana is the best paediatric infectious diseases physician in Whitefield, Bangalore.

Dr. Archana M has also received special certification and training for various courses like ESPID courses on antibiotic management and vaccination courses for immunity. She has also attended the certified training programme of Penta Child Health research in Italy for HIV patients. She has also attended the advanced certified course offered by Apollo Medvarsity on infection control and prevention. She has won several accolades for posters and papers presented during the International conferences held by WSPID and ESPID. Dr. Archana M has performed elaborate research works in her fields of expertise, which were published in nationally indexed journals. She is involved in training PG students studying DNB Paediatrics courses and offers guest lectures at CME and regional conferences to educate budding paediatricians. Dr. Archana M was the co-author of a case featured in a textbook on Paediatric Infectious Diseases and authored the FEFCON 2018 article on fever. She is one of the authors of the PG teaching modules on Paediatric Infectious Diseases for the IAP. She also shares expert advice and safety tips on infectious diseases like the Nipah virus and tomato flu in leading newspapers like the Morning Standard, Bangalore Mirror, and the New Indian Express. Overall, she provides treatment for prolonged and recurrent fevers, complicated drug-resistant infections, common childhood infections, congenital infections, tuberculosis, HIV and tropical fever.

Dr. Sanjeev Rohatgi is an experienced surgical gastroenterologist and liver transplant surgeon in Bangalore. He is currently practising as a Consultant - Surgical Gastroenterology, HPB & Liver Transplant Surgery at Manipal Hospital Whitefield. With over 25+ years of rich experience, Dr. Rohatgi has extensive expertise in complex hepatobiliary, pancreatic, and liver transplant procedures.

Dr. Sanjeev’s qualifications include MBBS, MS, DrNB - Surgical Gastroenterology, and prestigious fellowships such as FRCS (Fellowship of the Royal College of Surgeons) (Intercollegiate - UK), MRCS (Membership of the Royal Colleges of Surgeons), and FEBS (European Board of Hepato-Pancreato-Biliary and Transplant Surgery). He has also undergone advanced fellowships in liver, pancreas, and kidney transplantation, enriching his capabilities with globally benchmarked surgical proficiency.

With a strong foundation in gastrointestinal surgery and liver transplantation, Dr. Rohatgi offers advanced surgical care for both adult and paediatric patients. His clinical expertise spans the full spectrum of hepatopancreatobiliary (HPB) surgery, including liver resections for benign and malignant lesions, surgery for complex biliary strictures, cholangiocarcinoma, pancreatic tumours, and both acute and chronic pancreatitis. He is adept at performing minimally invasive HPB surgeries, ensuring quicker recovery and improved outcomes for his patients.

Dr. Rohatgi has a special interest in liver transplantation and brings with him deep experience in performing both cadaveric (DDLT) and living donor liver transplants (LDLT). His training has equipped him to manage complex liver surgeries with precision and care, ensuring optimal graft function and long-term patient survival. He is also proficient in pancreas transplantation and resection procedures for gastric and colonic malignancies, further extending his scope in gastrointestinal oncology.

In his role at Manipal Hospital Whitefield, Dr. Rohatgi prioritises patient safety, comprehensive evaluation, and a multidisciplinary approach to treatment planning. He maintains a strong commitment to patient education and transparent communication, helping individuals and families understand their diagnosis and treatment journey with clarity and confidence.

Dr. Rohatgi is an active member of renowned medical associations, including the Indian Association of Surgical Gastroenterology (IASG), the International Hepato-Pancreato-Biliary Association (IHPBA), the International Liver Transplant Society (ILTS), the Association of Surgeons of India (ASI), and the British Transplant Society (BTS). He continues to integrate evidence-based practices and innovative surgical techniques to deliver world-class liver care in Bangalore.

Dr. Deepak Jayaprakash Kaddu is a Consultant – Urology at Manipal Hospitals, Old Airport Road. He specialises in Robotic Assisted Kidney Transplant, Robotic Prostatectomy, and Robotic Partial Nephrectomy and performs all benign and malignant Robotic surgeries. He is also proficient in Endourological, Laparoscopic, Reconstructional urology, and Open Kidney Transplant procedures. He is the first Urologist to be part of the Robotic Urology program at Manipal Hospital, Whitefield, and is successfully heading and running it. Dr. Deepak Kaddu was part of the team that performed India’s First and the world’s second Level 3 Robotic IVC Thrombectomy with Suprahepatic IVC clamping at Kochi in 2022. He is the foremost urology specialist in Bangalore.

Dr. Deepak Kaddu has completed his MBBS from Sion Hospital, Mumbai, and his Master of Surgery in 2013, from the prestigious Seth GS Medical College and KEM Hospital, Mumbai. He stood 1st in the highly competitive M.Ch. entrance exam, MH-SSCET 2014, beating candidates from all over the country. After completing M.Ch. Urology with flying colours, he went into private practice for 4 years in Southern Maharashtra and North Karnataka region and was a leading consultant at Aster Aadhar Hospital, Kolhapur. After that, he was selected for the prestigious Vattikuti Robotic Fellowship (California, USA) in 2021, one among only 8 candidates from India.

Dr. Deepak Jayaprakash Kaddu completed his Robotic surgery training under the guidance of the esteemed Dr. Kishore TA at Aster Medcity Hospital, Kochi, one of the centres with the highest number of robotic Urology cases in India. He has performed and assisted in more than 300 robotic surgeries during 2021-2022. Dr. Kaddu then joined as a Consultant - Urologist at Manipal Hospital, Old Airport Road, working with the renowned team of Dr. Deepak Dubey. He was then promoted to be in charge of the Robotic Urology and Kidney Transplant program at Manipal Hospital Whitefield, Bengaluru. He and Dr Deepak Dubey’s team successfully performed the First robotic-assisted kidney Transplant in the area. 

Dr. Kaddu has recently done an observership in Focal Therapies for Prostate Cancer at the prestigious Imperial College, London. He has also done another observership at Guy’s Hospital, London, the largest Robotic Surgery centre in the United Kingdom. Over the years, the doctor published many papers and videos in international urology journals and presented at various national and regional urology conferences. He presented his Robotic Kidney Transplant paper and Video at the EAU European conference in Milan in 2022. He also received the best video prize at the Urology Conference Kerala 2022.

Dr. Deepak Kaddu has a keen interest in teaching and conducting academic activities. Apart from being a good clinician and skilled surgeon, he is empathetic towards his patients and listens to their complaints carefully with patience before embarking upon the treatment. He speaks Kannada, Hindi, Marathi, and English and can understand Telugu and Malayalam as well.

Dr. Vidya M N is a highly experienced histopathologist in Bangalore. She is currently practicing as a Lead Consultant - Histopathology at Manipal Hospital Old Airport Road, Bangalore, with over 17 years of expertise in histopathology and cytopathology. Dr. Vidya specialises in oncopathology, immunohistochemistry (IHC), fluorescent in situ hybridisation (FISH), and molecular oncology. Her proficiency extends to liver, gastrointestinal (GIT), transplant pathology, and dermatopathology. She trains postgraduate students and laboratory technicians and has significant managerial experience across various laboratory specialities. Dr. Vidya plays a key role in developing and introducing new diagnostic tests in the lab, ensuring advancements in pathology and patient care.

Dr. Vidya completed her MBBS and pursued an MD in Pathology, followed by a FRCPATH (UK), establishing her as a distinguished expert. In 2015, she further enhanced her skills with specialised training in molecular pathology at Christian Medical College (CMC), Vellore. Her academic contributions include award-winning research, and her work on body fluid analysis using Sysmex XT earned her the Best Paper Award at KAPCON 2012. She is pursuing a Master’s course in Molecular Oncology to stay at the forefront of advancements in cancer diagnostics.

Dr. Vidya has contributed extensively to pathology throughout her career through her research and publications. She has authored several significant papers in esteemed journals, including studies on the utility of FISH in bladder cancer diagnosis, diagnostic challenges in olfactory neuroblastoma, and rare case reports on hepatic neuroendocrine tumours and malignant melanoma of the ovary. She has also presented her research at prestigious conferences, such as KCIAPM 2014, where she discussed urine analysis using flow cytometry.

As a Lead Consultant in Histopathology, Dr. Vidya oversees key diagnostic areas, including oncopathology, digital pathology, image analysis, FISH, and solid molecular oncology. Her transplant pathology and dermatopathology expertise ensures comprehensive diagnostic accuracy for complex cases. She is dedicated to maintaining high-quality laboratory standards, implementing cutting-edge diagnostic techniques, and mentoring the next generation of pathologists.
Beyond her clinical and research contributions, Dr. Vidya is fluent in Kannada, English, and Hindi, allowing her to communicate effectively with diverse patients, colleagues, and medical professionals. Her commitment to innovation, education, and excellence in pathology makes her a highly respected leader.

Dr. Deepak Jayaprakash Kaddu is a Consultant – Urology at Manipal Hospitals Whitefield. He specialises in Robotic Surgeries, Uro-oncology, and Minimal Invasive Surgeries, and performs all benign and malignant Robotic surgeries. He is the first Urologist to perform Robotic Prostatectomy, Robotic Cystectomy with Ideal Conduit, Robotic Kidney Transplant, Robotic Partial Nephrectomy, and many other Robotic surgeries in Manipal Hospital, Whitefield. He has done the first and only Robotic Assisted Kidney Transplant in the entire Whitefield area of Bengaluru. Dr. Deepak was also part of the team that performed India’s First and the world’s second Level 3 Robotic IVC Thrombectomy with Suprahepatic IVC clamping at Kochi in 2022. He is a top urology doctor in Whitefield.

Dr. Deepak Kaddu has been meritorious throughout his academic career. He completed his MBBS from LTMMC Sion Medical College, Mumbai, and MS - General Surgery in 2013 from the prestigious Seth GS Medical College and KEM Hospital, Mumbai. He stood 1st in the highly competitive M.Ch. entrance exam, MH-SSCET 2014, beating candidates from all over the country. After completing M.Ch. - Urology, he went into private practice for 4 years in the Southern Maharashtra and North Karnataka region. After that, he was selected for the prestigious Vattikuti Robotic Fellowship (California, USA) in 2021, one among only 8 candidates from India. He also completed his Robotic and Uro-oncology fellowship under Dr Kishore TA at Aster Medcity Hospital, Kochi.

Dr. Deepak Kaddu is amongst the very few urologists in Bengaluru who do Retzius-sparing Robotic Assisted Radical Prostatectomy for Prostate Cancer in Bengaluru. Retzius Sparing technique for prostate cancer has better functional and similar oncological outcomes compared to the traditional technique. He is also proficient in Endourological, Laparoscopic, Reconstructional urology, and Open Kidney Transplant procedures. He is one of the few urologists who do Robotic-assisted Kidney Transplants in Bengaluru. Many patients demand this technique over the traditional Open Kidney Transplant at Manipal Whitefield, which is one of the 3 centres in Bengaluru doing it.

With over 10+ years in the field of Urology and 8+ years in the private practice in Urology, Dr. Kaddu has assisted and performed over 300+ Robotic surgeries during his Uro-oncology and Robotic Fellowship at Aster Medcity Hospital, Kochi. He has done over 100+ Robotic cases independently. Apart from specialisation in robotic surgeries, he is also excellent in Endo-urology and Laparoscopic Urology surgeries, having performed 1000+ endoscopic procedures and 150+ lap surgeries.

Dr. Kaddu has represented India and Manipal hospitals on International platforms in EAU, Milan, Italy, 2023 [Annual European Urology Society Conference] and AUA, Las Vegas, USA, 2025 [Annual American Urology Society Conference]. He has represented Manipal Hospitals and Bengaluru Urology Society on various national platforms like USICON 2023, Delhi, USICON 2024, Patna, USICON 2025, Chennai, YOU 2024, Nadiad. He has presented his unique technique of Retzius Sparing Robotic Prostatectomy in RUFCON 2025, Jodhpur, and Robotic Assisted Kidney Transplant Technique in RUFCON 2024, Bengaluru, which is a National conference for Robotic Urological Surgeries. His technique was well appreciated by the stalwarts in the robotic urology field. He has done many presentations at regional levels, like SZUSICON, South Zone Conference, and KUACON, Karnataka State Conference, BUS, Bengaluru Urology Society, consistently.

Dr. Deepak Kaddu has received the Best Video Prize in the KSS International Awards conducted by the Vattikuti Foundation at Jaipur, February 2025. He secured this award by competing with robotic surgeons all over the world. He was the only Urologist in India to win this Prize. He is the winner of the Best Video Prize National Conference, USICON 2024, Patna, for presenting his technique of Robotic IVC Thrombectomy. He received the best video prize in the Kerala State conference, UAKON- 2022, at Alapuzzha for his presentation on Robotic Kidney Transplant with an Ill conduit in a complex scenario.

Dr. Deepak Kaddu is extremely active in academics, with a special interest in teaching budding urologists. He has done an Observer post in Focal Therapies for Prostate Cancer at Imperial College London and a short observer post in Guy's Hospital, London, the largest robotic surgery centre in the United Kingdom. Dr. Kaddu has various publications in national and international indexed journals, especially on the topics of Robotic Prostatectomy and Robotic Kidney Transplant. Apart from being skilful in his profession, he is very compassionate towards patients - he explains the disease process thoroughly and explains the surgery outcomes and complications in detail. His behaviour towards the support staff and others is also commendable.

Mr. Umashankar L is a highly skilled physiotherapist in Old Airport Road, Bangalore, currently practising as a Lead Physiotherapist and Senior Executive - Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation at Manipal Hospital Old Airport Road, Bangalore. His clinical philosophy is deeply patient-centred, focused on restoring functional independence, improving quality of life, and preventing recurrence of injury through evidence-based, holistic physiotherapy care.

Mr. Umashankar’s practice encompasses a wide range of rehabilitation areas including fracture rehabilitation, replacement and ligament reconstruction rehabilitation, and manual therapy-based recovery programmes tailored to the specific needs of each patient. He is known for his structured, science-driven approach that integrates manual manipulation, osteopathic corrections, fascial release, and movement re-education. As a Certified Dry Needling Practitioner (CDNP), Certified Fascial Manipulation Practitioner (CFMP), and Certified Instrument-Assisted Soft Tissue Mobilisation Practitioner (CIASTMP), he combines a deep understanding of musculoskeletal anatomy with advanced therapeutic modalities to reduce pain, enhance mobility, and optimise physical performance.

In addition to clinical expertise, Mr. Umashankar has played a pioneering role in spreading awareness about ergonomic health and workplace injury prevention. He has conducted expert sessions and corporate workshops for leading organisations such as Infosys, TCS, HCL, Schneider, and SAP Tech, focusing on posture correction, workstation modification, and exercise prescription for desk-bound professionals. His extensive work in ergonomics has earned him notable recognition, including the Pride Award for conducting workstation modification sessions and accolades for his sustained contributions to employee health and safety.

His proficiency extends beyond orthopaedic care into neuro and onco rehabilitation, TMD (Temporomandibular Joint Disorder) management, and Pilates-based core stability training, making his practice versatile and adaptable to varied therapeutic needs. His approach blends traditional physiotherapy with modern movement sciences, integrating elements of osteopathy, dry needling, kinesiotaping, and manual therapy to treat both acute injuries and chronic conditions effectively.

Over the years, Mr. Umashankar has also contributed significantly to the academic and professional advancement of physiotherapy. He has delivered live talks and expert lectures on topics such as Physical Therapy in Arthritis Management and Rehabilitation in Revision Arthroplasty at Manipal Hospital Bangalore, and has been a speaker at prestigious conferences including the Indian Association of Physiotherapists Women’s Cell (IAPWC) – Karnataka and BSS Karnataka. His contributions to clinical excellence have been recognised through multiple honours, including the CEO Pride Award, Manyata Pride Awards (2016 & 2018), and a commendation for lasting contributions to patient safety and care at Manipal Hospital in 2017.

Mr. Umashankar’s professional memberships include the Indian Association of Physiotherapists (IAP), reflecting his commitment to continuous learning and ethical clinical practice. His work is marked by a compassionate, goal-oriented approach that places patient well-being at the forefront. He ensures that each rehabilitation plan is thoughtfully customised, addressing not only physical symptoms but also the underlying biomechanical and lifestyle factors contributing to dysfunction. Fluent in English, Hindi, Tamil, Kannada, Telugu, Bengali, Malayalam, and Badaga, he engages effectively with patients from diverse linguistic backgrounds, fostering a warm and communicative therapeutic environment.

Through his rich blend of technical expertise, teaching experience, and empathetic patient care, Mr. Umashankar continues to uphold the highest standards of physiotherapy at Manipal Hospital Old Airport Road. His work stands as a testament to the transformative power of rehabilitation, restoring movement, confidence, and independence in the lives of his patients.

Her field of expertise includes a wide range of procedures in Robotic Surgery for both Benign and Malignant Tumours of the reproductive system of women, Laparoscopic Surgeries, Laparotomies, and Obstetrics. She is a trained Console Surgeon and is passionate about Robotic Surgery, having performed 120+ robotic surgeries so far. She is the foremost Robotic Surgeon & Gynecologic Oncologist in Bangalore.

With a vast educational background and extensive medical expertise, Dr. Sasikumari M brings a wealth of knowledge to the field. After her MBBS, she completed her Diploma in Gynaecology and Obstetrics (DGO) from SETH G. S. Medical College, Mumbai in 2015. She then pursued her DNB from Government District General Hospital, Andhra Pradesh in 2017.

Dr. Sasikumari M furthered her education with a Fellowship in Gynaec Oncology and Robotic Surgery (Intuitive Training) from Manipal Academy of Higher Education (MAHE). Her experience of serving the Government of Maharashtra as a Speciality Medical Officer at Hindu Hrudaysamrat Balasaheb Thackrey Municipal Corporation Medical College and Dr. R. N. Cooper Municipal General Hospital has significantly helped enhance her surgical skills in her early career.

Dr. Sasikumari M has been accepted as an associate member of the Hellenic Robotic Gynaecological Society (HERGS). She has received the Society of European Robotic Gynaecological Surgery (SERGS) certification. One of her robotic surgery videos was featured at the esteemed 16th Annual Meeting of the Society of European Robotic Gynaecological Surgery (SERGS) in Madrid, Spain, in June 2024. Her representation of Manipal Hospital at this event brought great pride to the institution.

The dedication of Dr. Sasikumari M is evident through her numerous talks and publications at prestigious conferences. She presented a rare case of Ambiguous Genitalia at the Mumbai Obstetrics and Gynaecology Society Annual Conference in 2015, winning First Prize. Her presentation "Find Me if u can needle in a haystack" also secured First Prize at the 2017 conference. In 2020, she presented a talk on Robotic Hysterectomy at the Clinical Robotic Surgery Association, India (CRSA). She won the K.S. Robotic Surgery Video Award in 2020 for her work on Indocyanine-based Sentinel Lymph Node Biopsy for Carcinoma Endometrium.

Dr. Sasikumari’s immense contribution to the field has been recognised internationally, including at the 17th World Congress of the International Federation of Colposcopy and Cervical Pathology - IFCPC 2021, where she presented on SLNB - Sentinel Lymph Node Biopsy in Cancer Cervix.

Dr. Sasikumari's commitment to excellence, along with her clinical acumen and dedication to patient care, make her a valued member of the community of Obstetrics and Gynaecology as well as Gynaecological Oncology.
