Mr. Kishore Hajariya is a highly skilled physiotherapist in Bangalore, currently serving as a Senior Physiotherapist and Executive - Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation at Manipal Hospital Old Airport Road, Bangalore. With a Bachelor’s and Master’s degree in Physiotherapy (Neurology) from RGUHS, Karnataka, and professional registration as a Member of the Indian Association of Physiotherapists, he brings extensive clinical expertise and a deep understanding of neurological recovery to his practice. His approach combines advanced neurophysiological principles with patient-centred care, ensuring that every individual receives a treatment plan tailored to their unique challenges and goals.

Mr. Kishore’s professional journey is rooted in a passion for restoring function and independence to individuals affected by neurological conditions. His postgraduate specialisation in neurology has equipped him with in-depth knowledge of the brain, spinal cord, and peripheral nervous system, knowledge that he applies daily in the assessment and rehabilitation of patients with conditions such as stroke, traumatic brain injury, spinal cord injury, multiple sclerosis, Parkinson’s disease, and other neurodegenerative disorders. His therapeutic methods focus on promoting neuroplasticity, retraining movement patterns, and improving motor control to help patients regain balance, coordination, and strength.

At Manipal Hospital Old Airport Road, Mr. Kishore plays a vital role in the multidisciplinary rehabilitation team, collaborating closely with neurologists, neurosurgeons, occupational therapists, and speech-language pathologists. His clinical expertise allows him to design and implement individualised therapy programmes that address both the physical and cognitive dimensions of neurological recovery. He places strong emphasis on functional retraining, enabling patients not only to move better but also to perform daily tasks with improved confidence and autonomy.

One of Mr. Kishore’s key areas of focus is neurorehabilitation, where he combines manual therapy, task-oriented exercises, balance training, and sensory integration to achieve measurable improvements in mobility and quality of life. His sessions are known for being structured yet empathetic, helping patients overcome frustration and regain trust in their bodies. His hands-on approach, complemented by the use of advanced therapeutic modalities, ensures that recovery is progressive, sustainable, and holistic.

Beyond inpatient and outpatient rehabilitation, Mr. Kishore actively engages in early intervention programmes for patients with acute neurological conditions, aiming to prevent complications such as muscle stiffness, postural deformities, and secondary weakness. His proactive care model is built around early mobilisation and patient education, empowering individuals and families to take an active role in the recovery process.

As a Member of the Indian Association of Physiotherapists (MIAP), Mr. Kishore upholds the highest standards of ethical and professional practice. His ability to communicate fluently in English, Hindi, Kannada, and Bengali allows him to interact effectively with patients from diverse backgrounds, ensuring that care remains inclusive and culturally sensitive.

His dedication to continuing education keeps him abreast of global advancements in neurological rehabilitation, from motor relearning strategies to robotic-assisted physiotherapy and cognitive-motor interventions. This commitment to lifelong learning reflects his belief that physiotherapy is a constantly evolving field, one that demands adaptability, compassion, and scientific precision in equal measure.

Throughout his career, Mr. Kishore has been recognised for his patient-focused approach and his ability to motivate individuals to achieve meaningful recovery milestones. His calm demeanour and clinical insight inspire confidence among patients and colleagues alike, making him a respected figure within the rehabilitation team at Manipal Hospital Old Airport Road.

By integrating evidence-based techniques with empathy-driven care, Mr. Kishore Hajariya continues to transform lives through his work in neurological physiotherapy, helping patients rebuild not only their physical capabilities but also their sense of self and independence. His contribution stands as a testament to Manipal Hospital’s commitment to excellence in comprehensive neurological rehabilitation and restorative care.

Behera’s interventions are guided by compassion, patience, and precision. Mr. Parthiban A is a highly skilled physiotherapist in Bangalore, currently practising as a Physiotherapist – Junior Executive - Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation at Manipal Hospital Old Airport Road, Bangalore. With a Bachelor’s and Master’s degree in Physiotherapy (Neurology) and professional registration as a Member of the Indian Association of Physiotherapists, he brings specialised expertise in neurological rehabilitation and movement science to his clinical practice. His work reflects a deep understanding of the brain–body connection, where every therapeutic intervention is designed to restore function, confidence, and independence to individuals living with neurological impairments.

Mr. Parthiban’s professional foundation is rooted in scientific precision and compassionate patient care. His postgraduate specialisation in neurology has enabled him to develop expertise in managing a wide spectrum of neurological disorders, including stroke, Parkinson’s disease, spinal cord injury, multiple sclerosis, neuropathies, and traumatic brain injury. His clinical approach is built on the principles of neuroplasticity—the brain’s ability to reorganise and form new neural pathways through targeted rehabilitation. By integrating structured movement therapy with patient education and cognitive engagement, he helps patients regain lost abilities and reintegrate into daily life with greater ease and independence.

At Manipal Hospital Old Airport Road, Mr. Parthiban plays a key role in the multidisciplinary rehabilitation team, collaborating closely with neurologists, neurosurgeons, occupational therapists, and speech-language pathologists. His sessions are tailored to address both motor and sensory deficits while promoting balance, coordination, endurance, and postural control. He employs evidence-based techniques such as task-oriented training, motor relearning, proprioceptive neuromuscular facilitation, and balance retraining to help patients achieve measurable functional outcomes.

Beyond hands-on rehabilitation, Mr. Parthiban’s academic contributions highlight his commitment to the advancement of physiotherapy research and practice. He has conducted systematic reviews exploring the effects of yoga therapy on enhancing brain-derived neurotrophic factors (BDNF) and cognitive function, and the effectiveness of yoga in improving functional independence and mental health in Alzheimer’s disease. His scholarly work also includes the development and validation of a lower-limb task-oriented exercise programme for individuals with sub-acute stroke, demonstrating his deep interest in blending clinical practice with scientific exploration.

Mr. Parthiban believes that rehabilitation is more than restoring physical function; it is about rebuilding identity and confidence. His empathetic approach creates an environment of trust, where patients feel motivated and supported through each stage of recovery. He emphasises patient education and caregiver training, ensuring that rehabilitation continues seamlessly beyond the hospital setting.

His clinical proficiency is complemented by advanced certifications such as Basic Life Support (BLS), ensuring the highest standards of patient safety during all therapeutic interventions. He is also fluent in English and Tamil, allowing him to connect effectively with patients from diverse linguistic backgrounds and communicate complex therapeutic concepts in an accessible manner.

Over the years, Mr. Parthiban has earned recognition for his clinical excellence, including the Team Award at BPN, reflecting his collaborative spirit and consistent contribution to patient-centred outcomes. His balanced blend of academic insight, practical skill, and compassionate care defines his approach to physiotherapy, one that restores hope alongside health.

By integrating evidence-based techniques with holistic mind–body practices such as yoga, he brings a multidimensional perspective to neurological rehabilitation. His deep interest in the role of exercise and neurophysiological modulation in recovery reflects his belief that therapy should not only treat symptoms but also empower individuals to live more fulfilling lives.

At Manipal Hospital Old Airport Road, Mr. Parthiban A continues to make a meaningful difference in the lives of his patients, helping them rediscover movement, rebuild strength, and regain confidence through skilled, empathetic, and scientifically guided physiotherapy care.

column3: Lead Consultant - Hepatology and Transplant Hepatology
column4:
Dr. Sandeep Satsangi is a highly skilled hepatologist and liver transplant physician in Old Airport Road, Bangalore. He is currently practising as a Lead Consultant - Hepatology at Manipal Hospital, Old Airport Road, Bangalore, bringing over a decade of specialised clinical experience in the diagnosis, management, and advanced treatment of complex liver diseases. Renowned for his precision, evidence-based approach, and patient-centric care, Dr. Satsangi has earned a reputation as one of the best hepatologists in Bangalore, offering world-class services in liver disease management, liver transplantation, and multiorgan care.

Dr. Satsangi’s medical journey began with an MBBS from MNR Medical College, Sangareddy where he secured distinctions in several subjects like pharmacology, microbiology, social & preventive medicine, and paediatrics. He subsequently did an M.D in Internal Medicine from Kasturba Medical College, Mangalore, under Manipal University. Dr Satsangi was also awarded as the university topper in his MD examination. Dr Satsangi then specialised in the field of liver diseases and liver transplantation by completing a prestigious D.M in Hepatology from the highly reputed PGIMER, Chandigarh. Dr. Satsangi consistently topped his class and the exit exam held by the institution. He also performed extensive research and published extensively in the field of hepatology and received several accolades for his academic excellence. His early exposure to complex liver pathologies during his senior residency at PGIMER equipped him with extensive hands-on experience in managing acute and chronic liver disorders, hepatitis, cirrhosis, portal hypertension, and liver failure.

Currently, at Manipal Hospitals, Bangalore, Dr. Satsangi leads a comprehensive liver care programme encompassing advanced hepatology consultations, liver transplantation, and management of multiorgan complications associated with liver disease. His expertise spans from managing fatty liver, alcohol related liver disease, liver cancer, acute-on-chronic liver failure (ACLF), viral hepatitis, autoimmune liver diseases, cirrhosis, and liver complications arising from systemic illnesses. He is also actively involved in pre- and post-liver transplant care, where he plays a pivotal role in optimizing patients prior to a liver transplant and ensures long term follow-up of recipients for optimal outcomes. Dr. Satsangi also plays a key role in evaluation of live liver donors & their perioperative management ensuring their smooth recovery and liver regeneration.

Dr. Satsangi has contributed significantly to medical research and education. He has presented multiple award-winning oral and poster papers at national and international conferences, including ISGCON, APASL, AASLD, and INASL. His publications cover a broad spectrum of hepatology topics, such as liver transplantation outcomes, management of hepatitis C with direct-acting antivirals, liver disease in systemic disorders, and innovative strategies for ACLF management including extracorporeal therapies for liver failure. These contributions have positioned him as a leader and academic mentor in the field of hepatology.

In addition to his clinical and academic accomplishments, Dr. Satsangi has actively worked to improve community awareness and physician training in liver care. He has collaborated on telemedicine initiatives, such as the ‘ECHO’ program in Punjab, training community-level physicians in early detection and management of liver diseases. He also served as Assistant Editor of the Journal of Clinical and Experimental Hepatology which is the official journal of INASL, gaining experience in peer-reviewed publication processes and scientific review.

Fluent in English, Hindi, Telugu, Punjabi, and Kannada, Dr. Satsangi is known for his approachable and empathetic communication with patients and families, guiding them through complex treatment decisions with clarity and compassion. Combining advanced clinical skills, international-standard protocols, and personalised patient care, he is recognised as the best hepatologist in Bangalore for patients seeking specialised liver disease management and transplant care. His practice seamlessly integrates cutting-edge medical science with an unwavering commitment to improving patient outcomes, making him a preferred choice for patients across Bangalore and surrounding regions.

He remains an active member of professional bodies, including the International Liver Transplant Society, ASTS, IHPBA, and the Liver Transplant Society of India, participating in collaborative research and guideline development.

column4:
Dr. Shruthi H.S. Reddy is a highly skilled HPB and liver transplant surgeon in Old Airport Road, Bangalore. She is currently practising as a Consultant, HPB & Liver and Pancreatic Transplant at Manipal Hospitals, Bangalore. She brings extensive international experience and over a decade of advanced surgical expertise to the care of patients with complex liver, pancreatic, and gastrointestinal conditions. Recognised for her technical precision, academic contributions, and compassionate patient care, Dr. Shruthi has established herself as one of the leading liver transplant surgeons in the city, particularly noted for her proficiency in living donor and cadaveric liver transplantation, paediatric transplants, and complex hepatobiliary and pancreatic surgeries.

Dr. Shruthi completed her MBBS at Bangalore Medical College and Research Institute, followed by a Master of Surgery (MS) from the Postgraduate Institute of Medical Education and Research (PGIMER), Chandigarh. She pursued a Master of Chirurgie (MCh) in Gastrointestinal Surgery at AIIMS, New Delhi, and holds the prestigious FRCS from Glasgow. Her specialised liver transplant training was completed at King’s College Hospital, London, where she gained significant expertise in both adult and paediatric liver transplantation, including machine perfusion techniques. Further enhancing her surgical repertoire, Dr. Shruthi undertook advanced training in robotic HPB surgery in Japan, refining her skills in minimally invasive liver and pancreatic resections, complex vascular reconstructions, and single-port robotic procedures.

Currently, Dr. Shruthi serves as the Consultant - HPB & Liver and Pancreatic Transplant at Manipal Hospitals, Bangalore, where she performs highly complex liver and pancreatic surgeries. Her clinical practice encompasses living donor and deceased donor liver transplantation, extended hepatectomy, pancreatectomy, gastrointestinal oncology surgeries, and minimally invasive HPB procedures. She has also contributed significantly to the inception of liver transplant programmes at public and private hospitals across India, including her role as a visiting consultant at the Institute of Gastroenterology and Organ Transplantation (IGOT), Bangalore, where she facilitated organ retrieval and transplantation procedures for patients with end-stage liver disease.

Beyond her clinical practice, Dr. Shruthi is a passionate educator and mentor. She serves as a teaching faculty for the DNB GI Surgery Super-Specialty Programme, guiding the next generation of surgical gastroenterologists through hands-on training, research supervision, and academic mentorship. She has presented extensively at national and international conferences, including the IHPBA World Congress, British Transplant Society meetings, and Japanese Society of Hepato-Biliary-Pancreatic Surgery, showcasing her expertise in complex hepatobiliary surgery, minimally invasive liver resections, and outcomes of liver transplantation.

Dr. Shruthi has been recognised internationally for her excellence and leadership in liver transplantation and HPB surgery. She was elected as a Fellow of the Royal College of Surgeons, Glasgow, in 2023, and was one of two surgeons globally selected for the Japanese Society of HBP Surgeons observership in 2024. She actively participates in professional societies, including the International Liver Transplant Society (ILTS), International Hepato-Pancreato-Biliary Association (IHPBA), Liver Transplant Society of India (LTSI), and several Indian surgical associations, contributing to academic discourse, guideline development, and advocacy for organ donation.
Known for her patient-centric approach, meticulous surgical planning, and advanced technical skills, Dr. Shruthi is widely regarded as the best liver transplant surgeon in Bangalore for patients seeking comprehensive and cutting-edge HPB care. Her practice combines international expertise with local sensitivity, ensuring that patients receive world-class treatment within a supportive and empathetic environment. Whether performing complex adult or paediatric liver transplants, intricate pancreatic resections, or minimally invasive HPB procedures, Dr. Shruthi continues to push the boundaries of surgical excellence while mentoring future leaders in the field.

Ms. Shuchita Sharma’s contribution to the field of speech-language pathology is distinguished by her blend of technical expertise, patient empathy, and a strong research orientation. Her ongoing commitment to training, innovation, and patient education continues to enhance the standards of care in rehabilitation and communication sciences at Manipal Hospitals.

column3: Lead Consultant - Hepatology and Transplant Hepatology
column4:
Dr. Sandeep Satsangi is a highly skilled hepatologist and liver transplant physician in Kanakapura Road, Bangalore. He is currently practising as a Lead Consultant - Hepatology at Manipal Hospitals, Kanakapura Road, Bangalore, bringing over a decade of specialised clinical experience in the diagnosis, management, and advanced treatment of complex liver diseases. Renowned for his precision, evidence-based approach, and patient-centric care, Dr. Satsangi has earned a reputation as one of the best hepatologists in Bangalore, offering world-class services in liver disease management, liver transplantation, and multiorgan care.

Dr. Satsangi’s medical journey began with an MBBS from MNR Medical College, Sangareddy where he secured distinctions in several subjects like pharmacology, microbiology, social & preventive medicine, and paediatrics. He subsequently did an M.D in Internal Medicine from Kasturba Medical College, Mangalore, under Manipal University. Dr Satsangi was also awarded as the university topper in his MD examination. Dr Satsangi then specialised in the field of liver diseases and liver transplantation by completing a prestigious D.M in Hepatology from the highly reputed PGIMER, Chandigarh. Dr. Satsangi consistently topped his class and the exit exam held by the institution. He also performed extensive research and published extensively in the field of hepatology and received several accolades for his academic excellence. His early exposure to complex liver pathologies during his senior residency at PGIMER equipped him with extensive hands-on experience in managing acute and chronic liver disorders, hepatitis, cirrhosis, portal hypertension, and liver failure.

Currently, at Manipal Hospitals, Bangalore, Dr. Satsangi leads a comprehensive liver care programme encompassing advanced hepatology consultations, liver transplantation, and management of multiorgan complications associated with liver disease. His expertise spans from managing fatty liver, alcohol related liver disease, liver cancer, acute-on-chronic liver failure (ACLF), viral hepatitis, autoimmune liver diseases, cirrhosis, and liver complications arising from systemic illnesses. He is also actively involved in pre- and post-liver transplant care, where he plays a pivotal role in optimizing patients prior to a liver transplant and ensures long term follow-up of recipients for optimal outcomes. Dr. Satsangi also plays a key role in evaluation of live liver donors & their perioperative management ensuring their smooth recovery and liver regeneration.

Dr. Satsangi has contributed significantly to medical research and education. He has presented multiple award-winning oral and poster papers at national and international conferences, including ISGCON, APASL, AASLD, and INASL. His publications cover a broad spectrum of hepatology topics, such as liver transplantation outcomes, management of hepatitis C with direct-acting antivirals, liver disease in systemic disorders, and innovative strategies for ACLF management including extracorporeal therapies for liver failure. These contributions have positioned him as a leader and academic mentor in the field of hepatology.

In addition to his clinical and academic accomplishments, Dr. Satsangi has actively worked to improve community awareness and physician training in liver care. He has collaborated on telemedicine initiatives, such as the ‘ECHO’ program in Punjab, training community-level physicians in early detection and management of liver diseases. He also served as Assistant Editor of the Journal of Clinical and Experimental Hepatology which is the official journal of INASL, gaining experience in peer-reviewed publication processes and scientific review.

Fluent in English, Hindi, Telugu, Punjabi, and Kannada, Dr. Satsangi is known for his approachable and empathetic communication with patients and families, guiding them through complex treatment decisions with clarity and compassion. Combining advanced clinical skills, international-standard protocols, and personalised patient care, he is recognised as the best hepatologist in Bangalore for patients seeking specialised liver disease management and transplant care. His practice seamlessly integrates cutting-edge medical science with an unwavering commitment to improving patient outcomes, making him a preferred choice for patients across Bangalore and surrounding regions.

column3: Lead Consultant - HPB & Liver and Pancreatic Transplant Anaesthesia
column4:
Dr. Nagesh P N is a highly experienced anaesthesiologist in Old Airport Road, Bangalore. He is currently practising as a Lead Consultant - HPB & Liver and Pancreatic Transplant Anaesthesia at Manipal Hospital Old Airport Road, Bangalore, where he brings over two decades of specialised clinical expertise in HPB (Hepato-Pancreato-Biliary) and Multi-Organ Transplant Anaesthesia, including liver, kidney, and combined organ transplant procedures. With a strong academic foundation and extensive international exposure, he is recognised for his precision in peri-operative care, advanced airway management, and critical care support for high-risk surgical patients. His journey in medicine began with an MBBS from Bangalore University in 1997, followed by a Diploma in Anaesthesiology (DA) from Rajiv Gandhi University of Health Sciences, which laid a firm clinical base for his future specialisation. His commitment to advancing his clinical competence led him to the United Kingdom, where he underwent rigorous, structured training across renowned NHS institutions from 2005 to 2015, eventually earning the prestigious FRCA from The Royal College of Anaesthetists, London, and achieving his CCT in Anaesthesia and Intensive Care.

During his tenure in the UK, Dr. Nagesh gained advanced training in HPB and liver transplant anaesthesia, advanced training at St James 's University Hospital, Leeds UK, focussed observership at King's Hospital London UK, and also undertook a focused observership in London at one of the leading global centres for liver transplant surgery. This international exposure shaped his approach to anaesthetic practice, combining clinical precision, safety protocols, and multidisciplinary care coordination essential in transplant medicine. His decade-long experience within the NHS helped him cultivate a protocol-driven and outcome-focused style of practice, which he has seamlessly integrated into his work in India. With such expertise, he is considered among the best transplant anaesthetists in Bangalore, known for handling complex surgical cases that require exceptional intraoperative management and postoperative critical care planning.

Since returning to India, he has worked with leading tertiary care hospitals, where he was actively involved in transplant anaesthesia, paediatric difficult airway cases, and peri-operative support for departments such as upper GI surgery, surgical oncology, vascular surgery, ENT, orthopaedics, obstetrics, and gynaecology. His current role at Manipal Hospitals Bangalore involves leading anaesthesia services for high-end HPB surgeries such as Whipple’s procedures, Kasai procedures, biliary reconstructions, liver resections, deceased donor liver transplants, living donor liver transplants, kidney transplants, and combined liver-kidney and kidney-pancreas transplants. His expertise extends beyond the operating theatre into ICU care, critical organ support strategies, and post-transplant recovery optimisation, making him a pivotal member of the multi-organ transplant team.

Apart from his clinical excellence, Dr. Nagesh is deeply involved in academic mentorship and training. Being part of a DNB-accredited institution, he actively trains postgraduate anaesthesia trainees, guides thesis work, conducts structured teaching sessions, and has also contributed to policy development, including guidelines for pre-procedure pregnancy testing in adolescent patients. His experience as an ALS (Advanced Life Support) Instructor further highlights his role in emergency response training and team preparedness in high-stakes clinical settings. His colleagues recognise him for his calm approach in complex surgical environments, his ability to remain composed in critical scenarios, and his dedication to continuous learning and evidence-based practice. With his vast multidisciplinary exposure, commitment to safety, and transplant-focused expertise, he is sought after as one of the best anaesthetists in Bangalore for complex high-risk surgeries.

column4:
Dr. Shruthi H.S. Reddy is a highly skilled HPB and liver transplant surgeon in Yeshwanthpur Bangalore. She is currently practising as a Consultant, HPB & Liver and Pancreatic Transplant at Manipal Hospital Yeshwanthpur Bangalore. She brings extensive international experience and over a decade of advanced surgical expertise to the care of patients with complex liver, pancreatic, and gastrointestinal conditions. Recognised for her technical precision, academic contributions, and compassionate patient care, Dr. Shruthi has established herself as one of the leading liver transplant surgeons in the city, particularly noted for her proficiency in living donor and cadaveric liver transplantation, paediatric transplants, and complex hepatobiliary and pancreatic surgeries.

Dr. Shruthi completed her MBBS at Bangalore Medical College and Research Institute, followed by a Master of Surgery (MS) from the Postgraduate Institute of Medical Education and Research (PGIMER), Chandigarh. She pursued a Master of Chirurgie (MCh) in Gastrointestinal Surgery at AIIMS, New Delhi, and holds the prestigious FRCS from Glasgow. Her specialised liver transplant training was completed at King’s College Hospital, London, where she gained significant expertise in both adult and paediatric liver transplantation, including machine perfusion techniques. Further enhancing her surgical repertoire, Dr. Shruthi undertook advanced training in robotic HPB surgery in Japan, refining her skills in minimally invasive liver and pancreatic resections, complex vascular reconstructions, and single-port robotic procedures.

Currently, Dr. Shruthi serves as the Consultant - HPB & Liver and Pancreatic Transplant at Manipal Hospital Yeshwanthpur, Bangalore, where she performs highly complex liver and pancreatic surgeries. Her clinical practice encompasses living donor and deceased donor liver transplantation, extended hepatectomy, pancreatectomy, gastrointestinal oncology surgeries, and minimally invasive HPB procedures. She has also contributed significantly to the inception of liver transplant programmes at public and private hospitals across India, including her role as a visiting consultant at the Institute of Gastroenterology and Organ Transplantation (IGOT), Bangalore, where she facilitated organ retrieval and transplantation procedures for patients with end-stage liver disease.

Beyond her clinical practice, Dr. Shruthi is a passionate educator and mentor. She serves as a teaching faculty for the DNB GI Surgery Super-Speciality Programme, guiding the next generation of surgical gastroenterologists through hands-on training, research supervision, and academic mentorship. She has presented extensively at national and international conferences, including the IHPBA World Congress, British Transplant Society meetings, and the Japanese Society of Hepato-Biliary-Pancreatic Surgery, showcasing her expertise in complex hepatobiliary surgery, minimally invasive liver resections, and outcomes of liver transplantation.

Dr. Shruthi has been recognised internationally for her excellence and leadership in liver transplantation and HPB surgery. She was elected as a Fellow of the Royal College of Surgeons, Glasgow, in 2023, and was one of two surgeons globally selected for the Japanese Society of HBP Surgeons observership in 2024. She actively participates in professional societies, including the International Liver Transplant Society (ILTS), International Hepato-Pancreato-Biliary Association (IHPBA), Liver Transplant Society of India (LTSI), and several Indian surgical associations, contributing to academic discourse, guideline development, and advocacy for organ donation.

Known for her patient-centric approach, meticulous surgical planning, and advanced technical skills, Dr. Shruthi is widely regarded as the best liver transplant surgeon in Bangalore for patients seeking comprehensive and cutting-edge HPB care. Her practice combines international expertise with local sensitivity, ensuring that patients receive world-class treatment within a supportive and empathetic environment. Whether performing complex adult or paediatric liver transplants, intricate pancreatic resections, or minimally invasive HPB procedures, Dr. Shruthi continues to push the boundaries of surgical excellence while mentoring future leaders in the field.

Dr. Akshay P R is a highly skilled urologist in Old Airport Road, Bangalore. He is currently practising as an Associate Consultant – Urology at Manipal Hospital Old Airport Road, Bangalore, bringing over a decade of clinical training, surgical expertise, and patient-centred commitment to the management of urological diseases. Known for his structured thinking, precision in technique, and ability to simplify complex medical decisions for patients, he is widely regarded as one of the best urologists in Old Airport Road, especially for minimally invasive urological procedures and advanced endourological care.

With a strong academic foundation, Dr. Akshay began his medical journey with an MBBS from JJM Medical College, Davangere, between 2009 and 2015. During this period, he developed a deep interest in anatomy, operative planning, and clinical reasoning—skills that laid the groundwork for his future as a surgeon. His passion for surgical sciences led him to pursue an MS in General Surgery at the Government Madurai Medical College from 2016 to 2019, where he gained robust exposure to trauma surgery, abdominal operations, perioperative care, and emergency surgical management. This foundational training strengthened his operative judgement and prepared him for superspecialisation.

In December 2020, he joined the Department of Urology at Manipal Hospital, Old Airport Road, for his DrNB Urology training. Over three intensive years, he trained under senior urologists in a high-volume tertiary centre known for its complex case spectrum, advanced surgical infrastructure, and multidisciplinary ecosystem. This period helped him achieve proficiency across the full breadth of urology, including endourology, uro-oncology, reconstructive urology, renal transplantation, and laparoscopic urological procedures. His exposure to cutting-edge technology, such as LASER surgery, flexible ureteroscopes, modern imaging platforms, and robotic assistance, refined his technical confidence and adaptability. Dr. Akshay holds membership in respected professional bodies, including the Urological Society of India, Karnataka Urology Association, Bangalore Urology Association, and Youth of Urology. These affiliations fuel his continued learning and keep him aligned with evolving global and national guidelines in urological care.

His surgical expertise spans a comprehensive range of procedures. In minimally invasive and endoscopic interventions, he is proficient in RIRS, URS, VIU, DJ stenting, Mini PCNL, Holmium laser prostate surgery, TURP, TURBT, and cystoscopy-based interventions. He performs laparoscopic surgeries such as nephrectomy, pyeloplasty, ureteric re-implantation, and partial nephrectomy, and is trained in robotic urological procedures, including robotic VVF repair, robotic pyeloplasty, robotic sacrocolpopexy, and robotic nephroureterectomy. In reconstructive urology, he is well-versed in BMG graft urethroplasty, vesicovaginal fistula repairs, and urethral stricture management. His expertise also extends to renal transplantation, male infertility surgery, varicocele repair, hydrocele surgeries, orchiopexy, orchiectomy, and surgeries for penile malignancies. His ability to perform AV fistula surgeries further strengthens his contribution to renal care pathways.

Clinically, his areas of interest include kidney stones, ureteric stones, prostate enlargement, strictures, urinary infections, male sexual dysfunction, infertility, uro-oncology, and female urology. His practice covers evaluation, medical management, and surgical intervention as required. With his calm demeanour, ethical approach, and empathetic communication style, he strives to ensure that patients feel supported, informed, and involved in every step of their care.
Today, as one of the best urologists in Old Airport Road, Dr. Akshay integrates advanced surgical skills with evidence-based decision-making. His holistic vision prioritises patient comfort, long-term outcomes, and minimal postoperative discomfort. Currently practising at Manipal Hospital, Old Airport Road, he remains committed to delivering ethical, high-quality, and comprehensive urological care for individuals across age groups.
